# harness-kit

Project-agnostic AI agent harness with stage orchestration, bounded loops, and MCP context tools.

## Capability taxonomy
- Autonomy tier: bounded
- Recovery tier: resumable
- Simplicity tier: slightly complex
- Tags: mcp, memory, workflow, evals, provider-agnostic, cli, typescript, tool-discovery

## Intent profiles
- turnkey-coding: profile=turnkey-coding; keywords=turnkey coding, ship feature, coding agent, implement feature, build feature
- multi-agent-orchestration: profile=multi-agent-orchestration; keywords=multi-agent, orchestration, handoff, coordination, agent workflow
- drop-in-memory: profile=drop-in-memory; keywords=memory layer, persistent memory, session memory, recall, knowledge memory

## Model routing (Phase 5c — Optimized: 2026-07-25)
- Active phase: phase5c (multi-model optimized, +3.4% quality over Phase 5b)
- Tier shifts: Ultra-Reasoning (gpt-5.6-luna → architect, claude-opus-5 → feedback), High-Reasoning (claude-opus-5/gpt-5.5 primary, 9/13 skills upgraded from opus-4.8), Balanced-Coding (gpt-5.4 → prototype, claude-sonnet-5 → run-loop), Fast-Execution (gemini-3.5-flash), Universal-Fallback (claude-haiku-4.5)
- Primary models: gpt-5.6-luna (architect), gpt-5.5 (setup-bootstrap, context-engineering, retrieval-quality-ops), claude-opus-5 (feedback, pr, remember, understand-process, doubt-driven-development, deterministic-validation, review-breadth, ai-techniques-radar), claude-sonnet-5 (run-loop), gpt-5.4 (implement, prototype), gemini-3.5-flash (budget-aware-execution)
- Optimization: 360 test runs across all 20 skills + alternates; 15 upgrade candidates identified; avg quality +3.5% vs Phase 5b; highest upside: setup-harness-bootstrap (+9%)
- Validation: Phase 5c cascade health check (60 runs): 100% success rate, avg quality 0.817 (+3.4% vs Phase 5b 0.789), cascade health PASS, quality target PASS, no regressions
- Canonical config: harness.config.json > skillModelMapping.phase5c_optimization
- Ops: npm run harness:phase5c:cascade-health | monitor | revert | validate-all
- Fallback chains: All Phase 5b primaries retained as fallback[0-2] for auto-recovery
- harness-tool-discover: tags=mcp, workflow, tool-discovery

## Notes
- Use `npm run harness:profile -- --task "<task>" --json` to map a task to an intent profile.
- Use `npm run harness:mcp -- harness-tool-discover --intent <intent>` for on-demand tool routing.
